name: review-moderation
description: Checks every new review against your moderation policy, publishes the clean ones straight away and holds the rest for a person with the reason. Never hides a review for being negative, and never deletes one.

howItWorks.label: Checks
howItWorks.text: Spam, links, personal data, abuse, off-topic text and claims your policy does not allow

howItWorks.label: Publishes
howItWorks.text: Clean reviews at once, whatever their star rating

howItWorks.label: Holds
howItWorks.text: Anything uncertain for a person, with the reason, and posts it to Slack if you pick a channel

howItWorks.label: Tags
howItWorks.text: Each review's sentiment and topic, for the weekly sentiment report

plugins.reason: Posts held reviews to a channel so someone decides on them quickly
